title: Airport WiFi Login
scenario: Free airport Wi-Fi asks for your email password before connecting.

answers.A: Use the airport network listed on its official website or signs.
answers.B: Enter your email password to get online quickly.
answers.C: Use mobile data or a trusted hotspot instead.
answers.D: Use a spare password you do not use anywhere important.

explanation: Wi-Fi access should not require an email password. A password still reveals how the network is trying to capture you.
proTip: If a network wants your password, choose another route.
